note: Standard kinetic-Short SFX kit (free/commercial-friendly sounds from Pixabay). For a new project: copy the WAVs into <project>/audio/sfx/, add "assets" to its assets.json and "sfxKit" to its project.json. The subscribe button (ov-subscribe) is a video, not a sound: copy library/overlays/subscribe-button.webm to <project>/assets/overlays/.
